text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in big ways. Today's AI is good at specific tasks, like translating languages or driving cars. However, many researchers are working on "general AI," also called AGI, which could think and learn like a human. This technology might bring amazing benefits, such as curing diseases or solving climate change. But it also carries serious risks, including job loss and safety concerns. Some experts predict AGI could arrive within 20 years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, but one thing is clear: the future of AI will affect everyone.
